purpose: One ledger of every sample the programme has drawn from a shared pool, so that a new draw can prove it excluded all earlier ones. `python3 tools/workspace.py spent --verify` checks it. A spent sample is never re-drawn or re-scored; reading it for an analysis labelled exploratory is allowed where the protocol says so.
rules: Every draw from a pool is an entry, including development draws and screening lists, because later draws must exclude them.
Entries of one pool are ordered by `spent_on`; each entry's `excludes` (plus `siblings`, partitions of one draw) must name every earlier entry of its pool.
`evidence` points at the committed configuration that performed the exclusion and a string it must contain.
`record` is the committed file that describes the sample (counts and hashes); the member list itself may be gitignored when it carries IP digests.

pools.prism: PRISM (Kirk et al. 2024) conversations, grouped into components by shared participant, opening prompt or candidate set (cmri-portfolio-wave1).
pools.wildchat: English WildChat-4.8M from the local mirror of the temporal pilot, grouped by hashed IP (IP digests in configs are sha256 of the hashed IP).
